name: a valid security model
text:
security s
role viewer
role clerk extends viewer
user ana roles clerk
grant viewer read on Invoice
grant viewer read on Invoices
grant clerk write on InvoiceForm

name: a role cannot extend itself
text:
security s
role a extends a

name: nor indirectly, through other roles
text:
security s
role a extends b
role b extends c
role c extends a

name: a role may extend one declared later
text:
security s
role clerk extends viewer
role viewer

name: a role cannot be declared twice, nor a user
text:
security s
role viewer
role viewer
user u roles viewer
user u roles viewer

name: a grant needs a resource that exists, in any of the three metamodels
text:
security s
role viewer
grant viewer read on Nowhere

name: an entity, a form and a list can all be granted
text:
security s
role r
grant r admin on Customer
grant r read on Invoice
grant r write on InvoiceForm
grant r read on Invoices

name: a form needs access to its entity
text:
security s
role clerk
grant clerk write on InvoiceForm

warnings: role 'clerk' can use 'InvoiceForm' but has no access to its entity 'Invoice'

name: the access can come from a role it extends
text:
security s
role viewer
role clerk extends viewer
grant viewer read on Invoice
grant clerk write on InvoiceForm

name: a list can only be read
text:
security s
role viewer
grant viewer read on Invoice
grant viewer write on Invoices

warnings: a list can only be read, not 'write'

name: repeated roles and grants are warnings
text:
security s
role viewer
user u roles viewer, viewer
grant viewer read on Invoice
grant viewer read on Invoice

warnings: 'viewer read on Invoice' is granted twice
